faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Juvenile Justice Board Thanjavur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Juvenile Justice Board Thanjavur Recruitment 2026 is 30 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well in advance to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant and Session Clerk post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Assistant and Session Clerk post in the Juvenile Justice Board Thanjavur Recruitment 2026. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Office Assistant post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for the Office Assistant post is 8th standard pass. This is one of the entry-level positions in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can apply without paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for all the posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts in the Juvenile Justice Board Thanjavur Recruitment 2026 is 42 years. Age relaxation details, if any, will be provided in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Court Assistant combined with Record Clerk post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Court Assistant combined with Record Clerk post is Rs. 20,000/- per month. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q7. Can candidates apply online for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, the application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post or as instructed in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the qualification for the Assistant and Session Clerk post?
faq.answer: The qualification for the Assistant and Session Clerk post is a Bachelor's Degree in Science, Arts, Commerce, Engineering, Medicine, or any other discipline. Preference will be given to candidates with a Computer on Office Automation course or a Diploma/Degree in Computer.
